agent.problem: The card retells Matthew 8:7 when it says Jesus is ready to head over, then introduces the centurion's answer in Matthew 8:8. Its story-card citation should therefore be Matthew 8:7-8, not only Matthew 8:8.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

agent.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply an unseen wording detail from Matthew 8:16. The earlier cards show Jesus healing both by touch and by a word, so the setup does not let the baker reason out “word” rather than “touch.” This makes it a guessing-the-line blank rather than a meaning-based one.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
